entries.finding: Citation correctness does not imply faithful proposition selection or stable evidence updates.
Joint relation use differs from additive summaries; standard product kernels are an alternative explanation.
A frozen local history intervention transfers to another current text; answer-code and selectivity problems remain.
Neither tested observer qualifies for code-invariant disposition-intervention claims; formatting and recoding errors differ.
Intermediate body states rely on later access/computation; cutting access mid-network can be more harmful than never reading it.
Near-identical pooled states can have different next-token function; target/partition and KL decompositions replay exactly within numerical error.
Transporting an invertible coordinate change preserves the readout; refitting changes the regularization problem. Unobserved landmark directions are not uniquely identified.
Modest cross-task user correspondence is distinct from near-perfect within-conversation user/assistant matching.

All12 strong sparse arms and60 fold replays show axis-dependent ranking; EI/SN are near/all majority at the fixed threshold. Strong-source controls and bridge results remain pending; neural primary results have a separate entry.
All45 primary heads and225 saved-fold replays are complete. No primary Qwen10-minus-BGE pointwise interval has a positive lower bound; this does not test native task/history/direct decisions.

All36 primary binary heads improve log loss and Brier over fold-training prevalence, even for almost-majority EI/SN decisions. All144 pointwise conditional OOF/prior intervals are positive; this is a post-hoc diagnostic, not144 independent studies.
All9 no-PCA versus PCA pairs are complete; all18 pointwise pooled/mean-fold intervals cross zero. Compression removal did not demonstrate a general rescue under the frozen readout protocol.

All45 layer heads and225 saved-fold replays have270 paired comparisons against primary observers. Qwen readability profiles vary by outcome across all three arms rather than improving uniformly with depth; no added layer has a positive pooled interval lower bound versus E5.
Current material is available, but single-document structure, copy overlap, sparse accounts and tokenizer coverage constrain inference.
Standalone source-context similarity tracks Qwen continuation benefit; lexical and collector-cell conditioning reduces X associations. Japanese adjusted evidence remains underresolved.
